aiOverview.content: On Friday, April 10, 2026, Las Vegas honored Bruno Mars with a celebratory parade down the Strip, naming him the "new king of Las Vegas". The procession moved from the Bellagio Fountains to Toshiba Plaza, featuring a street renaming ceremony where Park Avenue became "Bruno Mars Drive". The celebration featured performances and marked his long-running residency.Parade and Event Details:When: Friday, April 10, 2026, starting at 1 p.m..Route: The parade began near the Bellagio, traveled down Las Vegas Boulevard past the Cosmopolitan, Aria, and Park MGM, ending at T-Mobile Arena's Toshiba Plaza.Highlights: A street renaming to "Bruno Mars Drive," a key to the city from Governor Lombardo, and a $1 million donation pledge by Mars to a local children's hospital.Performance: Mars and his band, The Hooligans, performed at Toshiba Plaza following the parade.Event Context: The event coincided with his April 10-11 stop at Allegiant Stadium for "The Romantic Tour".This honor puts Bruno Mars alongside Las Vegas legends like Elvis Presley and Frank Sinatra, recognizing his over 15-year history of performing in the city and his popular "Pinky Ring" lounge. On Friday, April 10, 2026, Las Vegas honored Bruno Mars with a celebratory parade down the Strip, naming him the "new king of Las Vegas". The procession moved from the Bellagio Fountains to Toshiba Plaza, featuring a street renaming ceremony where Park Avenue became "Bruno Mars Drive". The celebration featured performances and marked his long-running residency. Parade and Event Details: When: Friday, April 10, 2026, starting at 1 p.m.. Route: The parade began near the Bellagio, traveled down Las Vegas Boulevard past the Cosmopolitan, Aria, and Park MGM, ending at T-Mobile Arena's Toshiba Plaza. Highlights: A street renaming to "Bruno Mars Drive," a key to the city from Governor Lombardo, and a $1 million donation pledge by Mars to a local children's hospital. Performance: Mars and his band, The Hooligans, performed at Toshiba Plaza following the parade. Event Context: The event coincided with his April 10-11 stop at Allegiant Stadium for "The Romantic Tour". This honor puts Bruno Mars alongside Las Vegas legends like Elvis Presley and Frank Sinatra, recognizing his over 15-year history of performing in the city and his popular "Pinky Ring" lounge.
